_comment: Conclusions that a licence file alone does not settle: a fork that dropped its
upstream licence, a package whose opam field disagrees with its own LICENSE, a
dual licence stated in a README, or a work that ships inside another component.
Every entry names the primary source it rests on. Nothing here is a guess; an
unresolved component stays `undetermined` and appears in GAPS.md.

ocaml/menhir-20230608.license: GPL-2.0 (generator) AND LGPL-2.0 WITH OCaml-LGPL-linking-exception (lib/, sdk/)
ocaml/menhir-20230608.basis: menhir LICENSE splits the tree: THE GENERATOR is GPL-2.0, THE RUNTIME LIBRARY (lib/) and THE SDK are LGPL-2.0 with a linking exception
ocaml/menhir-20230608.linkage_basis: the GPL-2.0 generator runs at build time; only menhirLib and menhirSdk link, and they are inventoried separately
ocaml/menhir-20230608.note: The GPL-2.0 half of this package never enters the executable. Do not read the opam `license: GPL-2.0-only` field as a licence on the shipped binary.

ocaml/ocamlgraph-2.2.0.basis: LICENSE inside the pinned 2.2.0 tarball carries the linking exception; the opam `license:` field says plain LGPL-2.1-only and is wrong
ocaml/ocamlgraph-2.2.0.note: Worked example of why this inventory reads licence files rather than package metadata.

ocaml/memprof-limits-dev.basis: LICENSE at the pinned fork revision
ocaml/memprof-limits-dev.note: The checksummed source archive contains commit c2cced325a93d2271379f0712db85867b29dbee1 and is retained with the artifact.

ocaml/ambient-context-0.2.basis: upstream ocaml-tracing/ambient-context; the release tarball omits its LICENSE

ocaml/ambient-context-lwt-0.2.basis: upstream ocaml-tracing/ambient-context; the release tarball omits its LICENSE

ocaml/timedesc-3.1.2.basis: upstream daypack-dev/timere; the release tarball omits its LICENSE

ocaml/timedesc-tzdb-3.1.2.basis: upstream daypack-dev/timere; the release tarball omits its LICENSE

ocaml/timedesc-tzlocal-3.1.2.basis: upstream daypack-dev/timere; the release tarball omits its LICENSE

native/gmp.basis: gmp-6.3.0 README states the dual grant; COPYING is GPL-3.0 and COPYING.LESSERv3 is LGPL-3.0
native/gmp.linkage_basis: built as a static archive by runtime.py and linked through zarith
native/gmp.note: Taking the LGPL-3.0 branch is the only option that keeps the product proprietary, and LGPL-3.0 clause 4 then applies to the combined work.

native/pcre.basis: LICENCE in the pinned pcre-8.45 tarball

native/pcre2.basis: LICENCE.md in the pinned pcre2-10.48 tarball declares the SPDX id directly

native/libev.basis: LICENSE in the pinned libev-4.33 tarball offers both

native/zstd.basis: LICENSE (BSD) and COPYING (GPL-2.0) in the pinned zstd-1.5.7 tarball offer both

parsers/languages_crystal_tree-sitter_op.note: The pinned fork carries no licence file of its own. Attribution has to be taken from upstream.

parsers/languages_ql_tree-sitter_semgrep.note: The pinned fork carries no licence file of its own.

parsers/languages_r_tree-sitter_semgrep-.note: The pinned fork carries no licence file of its own.

parsers/tests_semgrep-rules.basis: LICENSE at the pinned revision of semgrep/semgrep-rules
parsers/tests_semgrep-rules.linkage_basis: test corpus: `git submodule update --init --recursive` checks it out, no code reaches the executable, and source_archive.py excludes submodules under a test tree from the archive
parsers/tests_semgrep-rules.note: The Commons Clause withholds the right to sell software whose value derives substantially from it. Nothing of it is conveyed: it stays in the build checkout.

parsers/cli_src_semgrep_semgrep_interfac.basis: undetermined: opengrep/semgrep-interfaces carries no licence file at the pinned revision
parsers/cli_src_semgrep_semgrep_interfac.note: Its generated ATD types compile into the CLI and its files ship in the source archive.

python/ordered-set.basis: upstream rspeer/ordered-set; the pinned wheel ships no licence file
python/ordered-set.note: The pinned wheel ships no licence file; upstream rspeer/ordered-set states MIT.

python/certifi.note: Weak copyleft. The certifi files themselves must be offered in source form.

python/packaging.basis: LICENSE in the pinned wheel points at LICENSE.APACHE and LICENSE.BSD, both present

python-runtime/cpython.basis: LICENSE.txt inside Python.framework/Versions/3.13/lib/python3.13 of the pinned python-3.13.15-macos11.pkg
python-runtime/cpython.linkage_basis: runtime.py copies the whole framework payload and Nuitka links the interpreter into the executable

ocaml/ocaml-5.5.1.basis: LICENSE at the ocaml/ocaml 5.5.1 tag; the switch export carries no source url for compiler packages
ocaml/ocaml-5.5.1.linkage_basis: the OCaml runtime and stdlib link into every native executable the switch builds

ocaml/ocaml-base-compiler-5.5.1.basis: LICENSE at the ocaml/ocaml 5.5.1 tag; the switch export carries no source url for compiler packages
ocaml/ocaml-base-compiler-5.5.1.linkage_basis: the OCaml runtime and stdlib link into every native executable the switch builds
ocaml/ocaml-base-compiler-5.5.1.note: The compiler itself runs at build time; its runtime and stdlib are what ship.

ocaml/base-bigarray-base.note: Virtual opam package: it records a feature the OCaml runtime provides and distributes no code of its own.

ocaml/conf-gmp-5.note: opam `conf-` package: it probes for a system library at build time and distributes no code. The library it probes for is inventoried in its own right. Here: GMP 6.3.0.

ocaml/conf-gmp-powm-sec-4.note: opam `conf-` package: it probes for a system library at build time and distributes no code. The library it probes for is inventoried in its own right. Here: GMP 6.3.0.

ocaml/conf-libev-4-13.note: opam `conf-` package: it probes for a system library at build time and distributes no code. The library it probes for is inventoried in its own right. Here: libev 4.33.

ocaml/conf-pkg-config-5.note: opam `conf-` package: it probes for a system library at build time and distributes no code. The library it probes for is inventoried in its own right. Here: pkg-config.

ocaml/menhirLib-20230608.basis: menhir LICENSE covers lib/ and sdk/ under LGPL-2.0 with a linking exception; its LGPL-3.0 clause applies to coq-menhirlib/, which this package does not contain

ocaml/menhirSdk-20230608.basis: menhir LICENSE covers lib/ and sdk/ under LGPL-2.0 with a linking exception; its LGPL-3.0 clause applies to coq-menhirlib/, which this package does not contain

ocaml/num-1.6.basis: LICENSE in the pinned tarball; the MIT text beside it covers the bundled test scaffolding, not the library

ocaml/calendar-3.0.0.basis: LICENSE in the pinned tarball carries the exception; the COPYING beside it is the bare LGPL-2.1 text the exception modifies

ocaml/js_of_ocaml-6.4.1.note: In the closure through alcotest-js and integers_stubs_js, which semgrep.opam declares without a test filter. A native macOS build almost certainly does not link it; verify-artifact settles that against a real artefact.

ocaml/js_of_ocaml-compiler-6.4.1.note: In the closure through alcotest-js and integers_stubs_js, which semgrep.opam declares without a test filter. A native macOS build almost certainly does not link it; verify-artifact settles that against a real artefact.

python-runtime/openssl.basis: libssl.3.dylib and libcrypto.3.dylib inside the pinned Python framework identify themselves as OpenSSL 3.0.21
python-runtime/openssl.note: Reaches the executable whenever Nuitka follows the ssl import, which requests and urllib3 force.

python-runtime/ncurses.basis: libncurses.6.dylib inside the pinned Python framework reports ncurses 6.5.20240427

python-runtime/sqlite.basis: _sqlite3.cpython-313-darwin.so in the pinned framework links no external SQLite and reports 3.50.4
python-runtime/sqlite.note: peewee pulls sqlite3 into the import graph.

python-runtime/tcl-tk.basis: Tcl.framework and Tk.framework 8.6.18 inside the pinned Python framework
python-runtime/tcl-tk.note: Present in the framework that runtime.py copies. Whether it survives into the executable depends on the import graph; verify-artifact settles it.
